integrity: All numerical checks are identified as finite corroboration; the proof uses an exact simplex height-density identity, exhaustive chamber algebra, and a primitive linear homogenization irreducibility argument. No external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is for one vertex-barycenter-centered right square pyramid; it does not cover other translations, arbitrary five-vertex polytopes, or component-intersection schemes. The result has not undergone independent mathematical audit. Equivalent unpublished computations may exist.
title: Eighteen cubic, quartic, and quintic intersection-body components of a centered square pyramid
